# IHG Hotels & Resorts accelerates Luxury & Lifestyle growth in Spain with Vignette Collection signing in Madrid


Renderings of San Bernardo, Vignette Collection[download](https://www.ihgplc.com/~/media/Images/I/Ihg-Plc/images/news/2026/ihg-vignette-collection-signing-in-madrid-spain-image-1.jpg)


Renderings of San Bernardo, Vignette Collection[download](https://www.ihgplc.com/~/media/Images/I/Ihg-Plc/images/news/2026/ihg-vignette-collection-signing-in-madrid-spain-image-2.jpg)


Renderings of San Bernardo, Vignette Collection[download](https://www.ihgplc.com/~/media/Images/I/Ihg-Plc/images/news/2026/ihg-vignette-collection-signing-in-madrid-spain-image-3.jpg)


**29.09.2026 (London, UK):** IHG Hotels & Resorts (IHG), one of the world’s leading hotel companies, has expanded its Luxury & Lifestyle presence in Spain with the addition of San Bernardo, Vignette Collection in Madrid. The hotel will bring IHG’s total open and pipeline Luxury & Lifestyle portfolio in the country to 21 properties, marking a significant milestone in its continued growth in the market.


Expected to open in March 2028, the 67-room San Bernardo, Vignette Collection will add a distinctive new stay to the heart of the Spanish capital, combining the building’s individual character with the strength of IHG’s global enterprise. It builds on the brand’s growing momentum in Spain, following recent additions including Finca Banyols, Vignette Collection in Mallorca; Casa del Compositor, Vignette Collection in Jerez; and Hacienda de la Vega, Vignette Collection in Carmona.


Spain is one of IHG’s priority growth markets in Europe, underpinned by its position as one of the world’s most visited destinations and strong long-term investor confidence in the hotel sector. Today, IHG’s portfolio in Spain spans ten brands across the Luxury & Lifestyle, Premium, Essentials and Suites segments, with continued expansion in high-demand destinations including Madrid, Barcelona, Mallorca, Málaga and Marbella.


Located on Calle de San Bernardo in central Madrid, the hotel will transform a partially protected heritage office building into a luxury hospitality destination. The redevelopment will preserve key architectural features while introducing contemporary design and amenities, including an internal courtyard, an all-day dining venue, a lounge and bar, and fitness facilities. The signing further strengthens IHG’s presence in one of Spain’s most important gateway markets.


The property is owned by San Bernardo 19 S.L. and will be operated by Hotel Collection International, one of IHG’s largest franchisees in the country. Spanish real estate advisory and investment management firm, Catella, has consulted on the deal, bringing deep local market experience.


**Willemijn Geels, Vice President, Development, Europe, IHG Hotels & Resorts, said:** “Madrid is one of Europe’s most dynamic luxury hotel markets, and this signing gives us an exceptional opportunity to grow Vignette Collection in the heart of the city. The combination of a characterful heritage building, an outstanding location close to Gran Vía and an experienced operator creates all the ingredients for a truly distinctive hotel in one of IHG’s most exciting key markets in Europe.


“Vignette Collection is resonating strongly with owners who want to preserve what makes their hotels special while benefiting from IHG’s scale, systems and global reach. We are delighted to be partnering with San Bernardo 19 S.L., Hotel Collection International and Catella to bring this exciting vision to life.”


Vignette Collection, IHG’s luxury conversion brand, brings together a family of one-of-a-kind properties in sought-after urban and resort locations. Each hotel retains its individual identity and story, while the collection shares a vision of offering a more authentic and considered way to travel. Through signature hallmarks such as ‘Memorable Rituals’ and ‘A Means for Good’, the brand creates purposeful guest experiences that reflect the character and culture of each destination and connect guests with the local cultural landscape.


Since launching in 2021, Vignette Collection has grown rapidly by offering owners of one-of-a-kind hotels the freedom to retain their property’s identity, character and name while accessing IHG’s global systems, distribution and IHG One Rewards loyalty platform. The brand has already passed the halfway point towards its original ambition of 100 hotels within ten years of launch.


Across Europe, Vignette Collection continues to build momentum in key city and resort destinations. The brand made its European debut with Casa da Companhia in Porto and has since expanded into markets including the UK, Hungary, Italy, France, Türkiye and Spain. Recent additions to its regional portfolio include Canary Riverside Plaza in London and Esperança Hotel in Braga, reflecting strong owner demand for a luxury conversion brand that preserves each property’s individuality while providing access to IHG’s global scale and enterprise platform.


*Numbers as of 30 June 2026.

## About Vignette Collection


[Vignette Collection](https://www.ihg.com/vignettecollection/hotels/gb/en/reservation) is IHG’s first collection brand and the newest addition to its Luxury & Lifestyle portfolio. It represents a fast-growing family of unique properties, each offering a one-of-a-kind stay in a destination to remember. Collectively different and proudly independent, Vignette Collection hotels share a vision to harness travel’s ability to benefit local people and places, weaving responsibility, community and locality together.


Since its launch in 2021, the brand has surpassed the halfway point towards its initial aim of reaching 100 hotels within its first ten years. As of 30 June 2026, the collection comprised 38 open hotels, with a further 46 properties in the pipeline. Vignette Collection was launched to offer owners of world-class independent hotels the opportunity to benefit from IHG’s powerful enterprise platform and global scale while retaining each hotel’s unique character, style and name.
